name: MEL01B (South)

lat.note: not geocoded: nominatim and all map/aggregator pages unreachable from this session (egress blocked)

builder.note: Hickory contracted to build MEL01B following MEL01A

developer.note: campus originally developed by Hickory Data Centres; STACK owns/operates since 2022

mw_it.note: 36MW critical IT, 'South' building, three levels, 12 data halls, air-cooled

authority.note: planning permit not found. Likely Wyndham City Council (site in Wyndham LGA) but not confirmed; PlanningAlerts shows a 20 Dec 2019 Wyndham application at 399 Palmers Rd for a warehouse (pre-Hickory purchase) and a March 2024 Wyndham application at 369 Palmers Rd for 'use and development of the land to construct a utility installation (data centre)' - applicant not identified

construction_end.note: DCD Nov 2025: construction completed. Conflict: ITK/aggregators say MEL01A and B occupancy permits Aug 2023, but the Aug 2023 STACK/Hickory release (source 6) describes only the first 36MW phase as delivered and the second as upcoming, and MEL01B topped out later - 2025 best supported

open_questions: MEL01B topping-out date unconfirmed (one search summary said Aug 2025)
